notes: Hostile source-only audit vs data/bill-text/119-HR-2066.txt (enrolled/Public Law 119-92, full read) + referenced source usc-15-683 (15 U.S.C. 683 / SBIA sec 303, 2024 edition, full read). No material issues: every figure ($250M/$175M/$475M/$350M/$125M, 50%, 300->200) and every statutory cite (7 U.S.C. 1991(a)(13); 10 U.S.C. 149(e); Sec 501(e)(6); Sec 103(9)/15 U.S.C. 662(9); 15 U.S.C. 683(b)(2); PL 119-92; passage dates) verifies verbatim, directions correct. COVERAGE LIMITATION: 15 U.S.C. 662(9) (SBIA sec 103, the private-capital definition amended by Sec. 2(a)) was NOT fetched/registered as a referencedSource — part-(a) claims are verified only against the bill's own strike/insert text, and the "exceptions for pension plans and college/university trusts" gloss (subclauses (I)-(III) of (B)(iii)) is only partially verifiable (subclause (II) visible via the insert; (I)/(III) unknown). featured_quotes are Congressional-Record sourced; the CR text is not among the fetched sources, so the two quote rows were NOT audited here (out of scope of bill-text + registered refs).
